'''Red Sin Chimaera''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], home to the [[Red Sin Chimaera Nebula]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] could be found lurking inside the cover of the Red Sin Chimaera Nebula. They would wait silently, striking at the last moment in hopes of a successful kill. For this reason, many thought of the Death Watch as animals, feasting upon the helpless to survive.

Aside from the Death Watch, [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] could be found in this quadrant, and [[Ikito Elfwannabe]] was sighted in the area. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were told to apprehend him on sight.
